text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm back!
choice_data_list: Welcome back, that was a wonderful run!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Heheh, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I really felt it click too, like... all 
the training results really paid off.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Something a little nice just happened.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Alright, good, good... I gave it 
everything I had—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Bari-yaaann!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation! Vari-yan! Whoa, what an 
amazing race you ran!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You're running in the Derby too, right? 
Looks like you're gonna pull off great 
results! I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: W-Wah...! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Not everyone was like her, though.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still, several people called out to me. 
They said "Great job!" and "Keep it 
up!"...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! That's right, Boss! I'm so happy! 
My heart feels... all warm and fuzzy 
inside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just the spectators who were 
moved by Win Variation's brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? What did you just—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Here's my card! I was so deeply moved by 
your passionate running—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I'd love the opportunity to interview you 
again sometime...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, whaaat!? M-Me!? Tr-Trainer, what 
should I do...!?"
choice_data_list: If you want to take it, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her running caught the eye of reporters as 
well, and they decided to run a special 
feature on her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And the earnest feelings Win Variation 
shared there became quite a hot topic 
online—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing her pure, earnest desire to one 
day beat her rival was truly touching..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"'You're such a hard worker. I hope you 
can become the lead star someday'... "

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I-It's... amazing... Interviews are really 
something else...
choice_data_list: Your feelings got through to them.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I guess so. It's kind of embarrassing, 
but it makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The next Japan Derby... With that guy 
there, it's the grandest stage to decide 
the best horse girl in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I was kinda chickening out 
too. Wondering if it'd really be okay..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still, knowing there are people watching 
me makes me feel like I can give it my 
all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was the Aoba Sho where Win Variation's 
charm gradually began to make its mark.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With the confidence gained here at my 
back, I want to charge ahead toward the 
Japanese Derby!"
